title: Mixed Event — An Ode for the Pure of Heart

meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart
meta.Outline: Toya suddenly ends up taking on a role as a wedding flash mob extra. But when he arrives at the venue, unexpected circumstances mean that the director is nowhere to be seen. As the possibility of a canceled show grows greater by the second, Toya meets Rui...

rows.Line: se_event_bridal_2021_002
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is the venue...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, you're serious about this...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I am. It'll be my first time performing in a place like this, so I want to give it everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, I get that you like being a nice guy and all, but you didn't have to agree to something like this...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I take that back. You would've said yes no matter what...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I was kinda looking forward to taking a breather at MEIKO's place once we were done with morning practice too...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He just had to ask Toya to do this...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a break here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. I'm getting thirsty too, so I think I'll go buy something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, you wanna head over to SEKAI?
MEIKO said that she'd be adding stuff to her menu and there's something I want to try too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
Pancakes with extra whipped cream, right...? It might be a little too much for me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? My phone's ringing...
Oh, it's Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Saki? Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Tsukasa's younger sister.
I have a feeling it has to do with the thing I was talking about...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right. You mentioned something about going to her Doll Festival party the other day too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it's rare for her to call me directly. I wonder what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello, this is Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<T-Toya?! Thank goodness...
I got a hold of you...!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I actually need to sort of ask you a favor...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A favor?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <If you have time that is...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was hoping that you'd be able to fill in for Tsukasa at work for him...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
<At work...?
You mean at Phoenix Wonderland...?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh, no! Not that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa works as an extra whenever Phoenix Wonderland is closed. He said that he has to be able to work wherever if he wants to become a star...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And today's one of those days, but Tsukasa isn't feeling all that well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He isn't? Is he okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yeah, he is. The doctor even said that it's just a little tummy ache. But he still says it hurts pretty bad, so I've been telling him to take the day off...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <He wouldn't listen and tried to go anyway. He said that a star can't let something like this get in the way of work.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa does take his obligations rather seriously...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Yeah, but he's hunched over by the door right now because of how much his stomach hurts...!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I even called his temp agency, and they said it'll be no issue as long as they have a replacement, so I was hoping that Tsukasa would agree to take the day off once I did find someone...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I know this is really sudden and I'll understand completely if you say no!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But who else would you call for this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
<I'm not sure...
It has to be a male cast member, but I don't have that many guy friends...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I tried calling Tsukasa's friend from his troupe, but I couldn't get a hold of him...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <No...! Tsukasa, you can't go...! I'm looking for a replacement right now...!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What's up, Toya?
Something going on?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, Akito.
There's something I have to do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'll do it.
I'll be his replacement.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You will?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, Toya!
You're the biggest lifesaver ever!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <It's okay. Tsukasa's always been there for me so...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Uh, Toya...
What did you mean when you said “replacement” just now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I thought I heard “his” name just now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be replacing Tsukasa as an extra today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh?
You're gonna be an extra?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, why are you the one that has to do this?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's not feeling well it seems, and Saki just asked me to go in his place.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's helped me so many times in the past, so I'd like to repay him somehow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you've never done any acting before. You really think you can be an extra?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That is true. I don't have much acting experience, but I'd like to give it my best shot...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your best shot...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Toya, are you still there...? Tsukasa just said that he'll pay you back later...!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Understood. Please give him my regards as well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <I will! I'll have him send you everything about where to go and what to do!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thank you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude...

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for agreeing to do this on a practice day, Akito. I promise to make up for it later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's fine. I know that you won't budge even if I asked you not to do this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'll be going then...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But him acting...?
As an extra for a wedding too...
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That should be enough resistors, plus any extras I may need. Oh, I should buy more crimp connectors while I'm at it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa! That's awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It's so cool how you're using stuff like this as props, Rui...!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Do you like it?
Would you like to make some as well, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Me? Really? Yeah!
I wanna make a rocket that can fling you into the sky!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. Let's make one together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While we're at it, why don't we make it so that you can fly with it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Me, flying? Like Tsukasa...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure it'll be quite an experience.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Although Tsukasa does always scream his head off when that does happen...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll head over to SEKAI so we can get started. Len, I'll need my phone for this, so if you don't mind... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've missed quite a few calls. I may've been a little too absorbed with my shopping.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're from... Tsukasa's sister and Tsukasa...? Oh, speak of the devil...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello... You sound like you're at death's doorstep, but this is you, yes, Tsukasa? How can I help?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Being an extra...?
Oh, you mentioned that before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Aoyagi's going in your place?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In that case, please take care.
You should get some well-deserved rest for a change.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Is Tsukasa okay?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He was scheduled to be an extra for something today but he unfortunately has a stomachache.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His younger sister, Saki, asked his friend, Aoyagi, to fill in for him instead...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But Aoyagi doesn't have much acting experience and he became somewhat worried.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He asked me to go and take a look to see if he needs any help or if they need more people on site.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, okay...
Are you gonna go, Rui?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa said that it was up to me and based on my interactions with Aoyagi during the School Festival, he seemed like a good kid.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On top of that, they have staff on site to help with any actual acting and direction, so I imagine he'll be just fine...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Len, have you ever been to a wedding...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What? A wedding?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I've only read about them in scripts and stuff, but I've never actually seen or been to one before. Why do you ask...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then it's settled.
Let's go together, Len.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure it'll serve as a good reference for your own shows as well.
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me, my name is Aoyagi. I'm here to fill in for Tenma as an extra today...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: Ah, I received a call about you just a little while ago. Everyone else is over in the waiting room that way.

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: Your costume should be ready too. Please head in that direction once you've changed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Uh, yes. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They even have a costume for me. It's probably standard procedure, but everything seems so well put together.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm glad I was able to choose something that fit...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But there's twenty of us. I'm really not sure what I should be doing...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have to think that something important is happening considering how many of us there are.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I need to do everything I can today for Tsukasa's sake.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I already checked the email that Tsukasa forwarded to me but...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It said, “The director will give you more details the day of...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't think I've seen anyone like that yet...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: Extras, we appreciate your patience.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: We have just received word from the on-site director and it appears that they will be running late due to a traffic accident.

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: For now, we will be explaining what you will be doing for today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I see. I'm glad they're doing this since I still wasn't entirely sure what to do based on what that email said.)

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: To start, this is supposed to be a surprise by the bride for the groom, so be sure not to tell the other guests about this.

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: As you were previously informed, you will be performing as a flash mob during this ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A flash mob...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When seemingly random people suddenly begin dancing on the street? I've seen couples use them to propose to each other on TV before...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But during the actual ceremony? I wonder what we'll be doing...)

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: We will be proceeding as follows...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: First, you will be placed among the actual wedding guests during the outdoor portion of the ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: At the end of this part, the minister for the wedding, the groom's friend, will say the standard “to love and to cherish, till death do us part” bit.

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: The groom will say, “I do,” and just as the bride is about to say the same, a man will exclaim, “Wait!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wait...?

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: He'll run up to the altar and spontaneously propose to the bride by shouting, “I love you! Let's get married!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: The bride will then choose her groom by saying, “He is the only one for me.” Everybody else congratulates them with a hearty “mazel tov”...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: And the music will start as the cue to begin dancing to cap off this part of the celebration.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's interesting, but I'm still a little fuzzy on a few parts.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I would think that a random stranger suddenly deciding to propose to the bride would cause the entire place to go completely silent...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Or maybe that's the part I should be trying to enjoy. I'm not entirely sure...)

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: I understand that you have already been given the dance routine and song that will be used, so please feel free to practice on your own in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: Further details will be explained to you later by the director, so we ask that you please remain patient.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: It's not as bad as I thought it would be.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: Yeah. I actually just signed up with this agency, so I was a little nervous coming into this.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: Really? It's only my second time here. I'm hoping that I'll be cast alongside famous celebrities someday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I assumed that professional dancers or people with acting experience like Tsukasa would be gathered here, but I guess that's not really the case...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Based on that email, we're supposed to be singing, dancing and doing a little bit of acting...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have the song and dance routine too, so I should be able to learn it all by the time everything starts.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Alright, time to practice...)

rows.Speaker: Male Extra
rows.Line: Um... Would you like to practice with us? We thought that it might be good to try singing together too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that too.
I guess around here will...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Hey, you're getting in the way! Can't you take that somewhere else? The dance team needs way more space than you guys!

rows.Speaker: Male Extra
rows.Line: Wah!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Are you alright?
Did you just bump into them...?

rows.Speaker: Male Extra
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm okay... We just grazed shoulders is all...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Alright! Time for the dance team to start practicing!

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff's Voice
rows.Line:
What?! Really?!
No, what do we do...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Male Extra
rows.Line:
The staff look concerned.
What do you think's going on?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll go take a look...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: You want us to take the reins...?! You really can't send anyone else...?! But...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: Uh, well... Apparently, the director's car was just rear-ended...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Rear-ended?

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: Nobody was hurt, but it sounded like the car isn't starting and they got into an argument with the people from the other car, so they won't be able to make it in time.

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: But the ceremony starts in three hours and there's no way we'll be able to find someone to replace them in that time...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: At this rate, we'll have to cancel everything and I was about to tell the bride...

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. Please, just give us some time...

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: So everything's gonna be cancelled?

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: That's too bad, but we don't really have a choice. We can't do much without a director.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do on our own? Or is there anyone here that could serve as a director...?

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: You serious? Directing isn't easy, kid. Especially when this many people are involved...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: This won't get off the ground unless you have everything sorted from start to finish. Think about it a little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Please excuse my ignorance.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wow! This is amazing!
So this is what a wedding hall is like? It's so beautiful!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it is.
The venue itself is designed to be naturally photogenic and quite a sight to behold, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, is that...?
Len, would you mind hiding for a moment?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, no problem!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*...
I managed to get out of there...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Is everything actually going to be cancelled just like that?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If only Tsukasa were here. He might've been able to do something about this...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: A man walking away as he leaves a wedding venue in the distance...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: Very nice. I can see it already...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This voice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello. How is your first show going, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro...?
Outside the wedding hall

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa contacted you just for me...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't know what to say.
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, don't mind me. I simply came here to see what was going on and possibly learn something from it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Learn something?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. A wedding is a once-in-a-lifetime show in a way, you see?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonists swear to love each other while wearing special outfits. You could even say it's more of a show than actual shows or plays, no?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sadly, that show may not be happening today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. I didn't realize that had happened.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And there's nobody else here that can act as a replacement director?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, there isn't.
One person seemed like a veteran, but not exactly a director...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They even said that it'd be too hard for anyone there to look after everyone and bring them all together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see. Tell me, when is everything scheduled to start...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
2 pm...
It's 11 am now, so we only have about three hours...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Three hours...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That may be just enough time...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The scenario itself looks rather simple and the cast already has everything they need, including costumes.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is where they'll need me to actually direct...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: People seem to be gathering in the garden. Do you know what's happening?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, those are the other extras and...
Everyone, thank you so much for gathering here today for this ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe she's the bride.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: I received word from the staff that the director won't be able to make it today, and I've decided to cancel the little surprise we planned for today...

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: I will make sure to let your agency know so that you will be compensated for what was scheduled today.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: I appreciate you all coming today, but you are now free to go. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: I guess, let's go home then...

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It's not like there's anything we can do about it so...

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel so bad for her. She planned everything and gathered all these people just for today...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If it were me in her shoes and I wasn't able to participate in an event I practiced so hard for, I'm not sure what I'd do...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure about doing this?

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line:
Huh?
I mean... What choice do I have...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you gathered everyone here today just for this moment.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There must be a reason behind going through all that trouble...

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line:
Yes, there is...
I feel awful about having to cancel this too.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: The truth is, my fiancé did this when he proposed to me. There was singing and dancing, and he gave me my engagement ring in the end...

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: I always thought that he was a straight arrow who shied away from being flashy, but he did it all just to see me smile and laugh...

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: That's why I want him to smile back for me, but there's nothing I can do now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Smile and laugh...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh what a fool I've been...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (How did I allow myself to hesitate for even a moment considering I already make shows with them...)

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: I need to get ready myself, so if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please wait...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: Who are you...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My name is Rui Kamishiro, the director/actor for one of the stages at Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland? As in the amusement park?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The very same. If you'll allow me, I'd like to take over as the director of your little performance.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: Huh? But you'd have no time to prepare until the ceremony starts. How do you plan on...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fear not. Leave everything to me and I promise to give you the perfect performance.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...
But...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The weather is beautiful. Not a single cloud in the sky. Is this not the ideal day to celebrate such an occasion...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You should be smiling on a day like this, not frowning. The bride and the groom together.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
But are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, indeed.
Let's make today's ceremony one to remember.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'd like to ask a few questions about you and your fiancé just to get my bearings.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line:
About us...?
Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line:
Oh, the staff. Excuse me...!
I'd like to discuss a few things with the extras once more if you don't mind...!

rows.Speaker: Hall Staff
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, yes, of course!
Right this way...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, we shouldn't be celebrating just yet. It'll have to wait until after our show succeeds.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's get everything ready for the opener!
Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So I, Kamishiro, will be taking over as the director of this performance today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with all of you. Let's make the most out of today's ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: I thought our bit got cancelled. Are we really doing this?

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: And that kid's gonna direct? He's young, but seems pretty calm. Can he really pull this off?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (A cloud of doubt still seems to be hanging over them. I suppose that should be expected...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, that's enough chatting for now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We only have two and a half hours until the ceremony starts. Whether we like it or not, the curtains will be going up at that time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How you perceive that moment, be it fearfully or eagerly, will all depend on what you decide to do right now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Whoa...
He just turned everything on its head...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So this is what a director can do...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, it's time we started rehearsing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Since we're limited on time, we'll still go with when the bride and groom say their vows, but I'll be making one small addition to that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A small addition?
What do you have in mind?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, then here's a question for you.
What do you think is missing from the original idea?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's missing...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm not sure...
Does it have to do with how the other guests should feel? Something about that felt a little strange to me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I thought that man proposing to the bride so suddenly would only startle the other guests in reality...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Correct. Well done.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How the other guests feel that moment when he professes his love is the key...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What if there's some unrequited love that nobody else knows about there?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This was used in quite a few older movies, so I'm sure some of the guests will recognize what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, how will these guests react when they realize that this was all an act?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They'll say, “Oh, it was just an act,” and feel relieved...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. They'll finally be able to relax and laughter will begin to fill the room.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But some will definitely feel like they've been deceived and will have no interest what comes next. My addition will attempt to counteract those sentiments.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: So spill it already. What do you plan on doing for that part?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I shall.
For that part...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll increase the men objecting to this wedding from one to three.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why three?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's think about that for a second. How would you feel if that many objected to the wedding at once?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Female Extra
rows.Line: It'll make the bride look really popular, I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Male Extra
rows.Line: No, it'll feel like some kind of weird surprise! Right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You're both correct.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By increasing the objectors to three, it'll draw more attention to the bride.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure you've all seen something like this before in a fairy tale.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At the same time, having three men instead of one object at once will tell the guests that this is staged and not real.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, they'll immediately realize that this is a show or a prank of sorts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The original scenario would've only served to startle or worry the other guests. It may've even led to further trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (By having so many people object at the same time, it'll ease any tension, give everyone an opportunity to realize what's going on and let them laugh a little.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So let us decide who will have the honor of proposing to the bride right now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Gentlemen, I'd like to know about any talents you may possess, if you will...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line:
Talents?
For me, that's dancing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, dancing.
How about you?

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: I used to play basketball, so I know how to dribble pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: They're not great or anything, but I like drawing caricatures of people...

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: I'm good at origami.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: I can...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Last but not least, how about you, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm good at...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (To most people, that would be playing the piano or the violin...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But that's in the past now. The thing I want to say right now is...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Singing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I believe we're all set then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have our resident basketball player, origami artist and singer be the ones who propose to the bride! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: What?! Why'd you choose them...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You'll find out why during the wedding.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're actors now with proper roles to fill.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Time to break a leg, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
I'll do my best, Kamishiro.
Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that we have those roles filled, we'll need to choose who will be leading the dance part next.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Hey, you really have this under control...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I'm not sure what you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Your directing.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: It feels all wrong. We're already short on time and you're just deciding who does what based on what they happen to be able to do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, there's no need for any auditioning if that's what you're asking.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I chose those who I believe will do this ceremony the most justice.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: That's just your opinion, kid. They don't really know much about acting either from what I can tell...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: I'm in a theatre troupe and I've been doing this for a while now. Someone with more experience and acting skills would be a better choice, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Acting skills, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be honest, everybody here is more or less the same in terms of that...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I understand that some people are indeed born actors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Their presence, how they go about themselves day to day, it all sets them apart from the rest of us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But only so many of them actually exist.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: Then what the hell are you trying to do here...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do not have this sort of ace in the hole, so I'm relying on your natural talents to make the most of this situation.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unless you are that very star we need right now. Are you?

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line:
What?! You...!
How can you say that when you clearly don't have much experience doing this...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see your point. However, I also know that experience only begins to matter after you've reached a certain level.

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now then, we have little time to spare. Next, we'll need to...

rows.Speaker: Condescending Extra
rows.Line:
I can't deal with this guy!
I'm outta here...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?! Please, wait...!
se_event_bridal_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He really left...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, this is awkward...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was hoping that he wouldn't cause such a fuss if what he said about being in a theatre troupe were true.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you sure about just letting him go? We'll be down a person...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this is less than ideal...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we don't have a choice. We don't have the luxury to worry about this right now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I'll need the dance lead to sing as well. Would anyone like to volunteer?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh dear. They've all gone quiet...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Leading the dance is just as important as being one of the men proposing to the bride...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But today's ceremony is being held outside. There won't be much in the way of lights or acoustics to help cover up mistakes, so someone with good fundamentals would be best for this...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Our leaver was my leading candidate, but I'm guessing he also would've let things go to his head and caused trouble for everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If only there were someone here with experience singing and dancing in front of a crowd...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Singing and dancing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There is someone that could help us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So what did you call me over for...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe Akito will be able to lead the dance portion.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, please. I beg you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Tell me... What's in it for me if I do say yes to this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Listen, Toya. I'm not doing a gig for some wedding or anything like that, so find someone else.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For some wedding, eh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's how you truly feel, then I won't recommend that you join us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To you, this may be just another uninteresting stage or venue.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But to the bride and groom, this is a once-in-a-lifetime event. If you're unable to see that, then I won't ask you to participate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose that this role may be too much for you as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're just egging me on to join now, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I really don't like people who try to manipulate others into doing stuff for them like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, so I've been made.
Please excuse my indiscretion.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're still grinning...
You don't actually feel bad, do you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In actuality, who knows...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Now you're just trying to start something, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I am simply trying to give this ceremony the show that it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'll do anything right now if it means convincing you to join us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I feel no guilt over that whatsoever.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So that's how it is...
But I still don't like it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not agreeing to this if it means working with someone like him. Got it, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I understand...
I'm sorry, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I apologize for inviting you without actually thinking about it first.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's the night festival all over again. I relied on you too much that time too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's different...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But please just know this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro took over as the director for this performance pro bono.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The real director ran into some trouble and couldn't make it in time today. For a moment, everything was set to be cancelled.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But the bride has been planning this for quite some time all just to see her fiancé smile.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I want to make this happen if it really means that much to them...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And Kamishiro feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He wants this to succeed no matter what for the bride's sake. Please, try to understand at least that much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, I apologize for dumping this on you so suddenly. I promise to pay you back later...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fine, what do I need to do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll do it. You happy now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still don't like the way you do things, Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I know that feeling of wanting to make something happen no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is for Toya, not you, got it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I understand. I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This means you owe me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course.
I promise to return the favor.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, we need to start rehearsing.
Do you have the time, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's 12:30... We only have an hour and a half until it starts?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What?! An hour and a half?!
Dude, you serious?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, very!
We'll need to get started right away, Shinonome! The costumes are all ready...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
By the way, Aoyagi...
Have you ever thought about appearing from the sky...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
T-The sky...?!
No, not really...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hold up!
What are you up to now?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was just a joke.
We need to go! Hurry!
Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting, everybody!
We have someone to lead the dance team now.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: Him? He looks really young too...

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: Is he really gonna be okay just being thrown into the deep end like this...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My name is Akito Shinonome. I'll be a part of the dance team with you all today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'd like to use my stage experience to make this the best ceremony possible with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: He seems alright...

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: He has experience too, so why not, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No matter how many times I see it, he feels like a different person when he gets serious...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Akito might be the better choice for proposing to the bride too...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, it's well past time we started rehearsing. If you'll all gather...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Louder! You need to articulate more when you say that! Like someone's planted a bomb in your molars that will explode if you close your mouth!

rows.Speaker: Extra A
rows.Line: A bomb?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You there, face forward and stick your chest out! Imagine that you're about to deploy a laser from your shoulder!

rows.Speaker: Extra B
rows.Line: A laser...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And you! Hands off your hips! You're a human, not a robot! You're capable of more fluid movements! However, if you wish to become a robot...

rows.Speaker: Extra C
rows.Line: O-Okay! I'm not sure what you're saying, but I'll try harder!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's always acting so strange when he's with Tsukasa and I assumed that was just the way he was, but he takes acting direction so seriously...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (No, what if this is the real Rui Kamishiro...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Aoyagi, you've stopped. Is something the matter? We don't have much time left...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: R-Right... I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, that looked good.
Let's just go over that last part again just to make sure.

rows.Speaker: Female Extra
rows.Line: Sure. But you're such a great teacher! This routine looked so hard, but you made everything so much easier...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm really just doing the dance routine Kamishiro told me to do...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: 45 minutes left...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll need to rehearse together with the dance team soon...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, no. I don't think so.
I was just doing some thinking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose it's not good to keep secrets just before the curtains go up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was thinking about that little conversation we just had.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our conversation...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When we invited Shinonome to join us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've been told many times for as long as I can remember that I'm one that does whatever it takes to make my goals a reality.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In truth, when I start thinking about an idea for a show, I block just about everything else out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: At times I let my obsessions get the best of me and I would ultimately end up all alone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've pushed cast members a little too far sometimes so that they'd do what I envisioned...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that didn't necessarily mean they wanted to be in my show, and it hardly amounted to us respecting one another. They all ended up leaving after a while.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was reminiscing a little about that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Respect for one another...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that is very important...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I also understand why you do things the way you do, Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Someone in my family thinks in sort of the same way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When it comes to something he truly loves, he'll give no quarter and won't compromise...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't understand what he was doing at first. It puzzled me how he could torment a family member over such a thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But now I understand a little.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's able to see what he sees because he gives what he loves everything he has.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And he wanted me to get a glimpse of that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, I kept rambling on... I just wanted to say that I understand your thinking is all...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I believe that Akito decided to help us because he came to an understanding that your way would work in this case.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There are certain things that we aren't willing to compromise on as well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And what would that be for you...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Surpassing a legendary event that happened some time ago.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Surpassing a legendary event...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure that show will be one for the ages.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure it will be.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we gonna start rehearsing or not? We're running out of time...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then let's get ready for the home stretch...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, not bad.
This should make for a wonderful ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: Yay...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I believe you're all still capable of doing more. I'd like for you all to do everything you can to make this show as good as it can be.

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: Everything we can?

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: Oh, like getting that turn at the end down...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right. You'll look better if you stick that last turn. Would you like to practice that now?

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: And I mumbled one of my lines...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you could've been a little bit clearer there. How about we practice that part once more?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Excellent, I could not ask for better morale...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
All that's left is the finale.
Unfortunately, I'm not sure that we have the time to further refine it...
<Rui! Hey, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, that's right...
Outside the wedding hall

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Len.
I left you all alone after we took a look at this place, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<No, it's okay!
But I did hear what was going on!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You're wondering what you should do about the finale, right?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What if you tried “that”...?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You know, the thing you were out shopping for earlier?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What if you made some adjustments to that? Like... Adding that thing over there to it...!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
That may indeed work.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Len.
This may make for a great finale.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Really? Hehe. Great!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I hope today's wedding goes well!>
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm finally done with everything dad asked me to do, so maybe I'll go to MEIKO's place and... Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's with all those people gathering over there? I wonder what's going on...
Wedding Ceremony Hall

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm... Oh, it's a wedding...!
Maybe I can get a peek at the bride... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Male Extra
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. I can't believe that I got hurt just 30 minutes before the ceremony...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you're gonna have a tough time dancing. For now, please sit down...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*... Now what...?
If only we could find a replacement...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, Akito?!
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Huh? That voice... An?
I should be asking you that.
Also, I don't have time to chat...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hang on, you might work. Pretty sure there was an extra costume lying around...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Forget it, I'll explain later. Just put this on for now! You have five minutes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? I still don't know what's going on! Hey, answer me...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So this outfit's...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: For a little performance we're gonna do during the wedding, but one of our dancers got hurt.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Luckily, you're here. You of all people should be able to learn everything and pull it off when it counts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! You seriously want me to be in your show?! Don't you think that's a little much even coming from you? Also, why are you here to begin with...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I was roped into this too. You can ask him for more details...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You too, Toya? And Kamishiro?!
Seriously, how did this happen?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, Shiraishi. I heard from our other dancer that you'll be replacing them. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, since you're also a hall monitor, I'll appreciate it if you'll be willing to overlook my indiscretions today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh, sure. Just don't go overboard, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, it's nearly showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You've all done very well to learn everything in such a short span of time today. I believe we're ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All that's left is to have fun under this beautiful sun!

rows.Speaker: Extras
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still don't really have the full picture yet, but it sounds fun! Let's do this...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sometimes I'm glad you're such a good sport. Anyways, we don't have time. Let's start from the top.

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: Now, minister, if you will...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We're almost up...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This feels pretty different from the events we usually do...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (So many guests. They all came here today to be a part of today's celebration.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (If we don't get it right...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be fine, Aoyagi. I'm sure of it. Just try to remember what I said if you do get lost...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe in one thing when it comes to all shows...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That the ones who have the most fun are the winners...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, it's showtime!

rows.Speaker: Minister
rows.Line: Do you take each other as lawfully wedded spouses to have and to hold, for better or for worse, in sickness and in health, to love and cherish, till death do you part?

rows.Speaker: Groom
rows.Line: I do...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, wait! I object!!

rows.Speaker: Groom
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: What's going on?

rows.Line: Wait! I object too!

rows.Line: I can't let this happen either!

rows.Line: Please, just give me one more chance before you say those words!

rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Line:
I beg you! Please rethink things!
Watch this!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: No! I'm the man who's been doing nothing but this since elementary school! I'm Hasegawa the Dribbler! This is still easy mode!

rows.Line: Dribbling a ball?! Here of all places?! He's super good but still...!
se_event_bridal_2021_003

rows.Line: H-He's so cool...!

rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: Oh, you're so wonderfully talented...

rows.Speaker: Groom
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I think I get it now...
Are they all people that can do things the bride likes...? That means Toya's gonna...

rows.Line: You're not sure about how you should feel here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
I've never acted before and don't have a good sense of what to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Then let's imagine the thing you desire the most is sitting right in front of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that very thing is about to be taken away from you by someone else.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And there's only one way for you to take it back, which is to sing for it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Win it back by singing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think I have a better idea now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, good.
Now, go sing your heart out!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I... I'll sing with every fiber of my being for you...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please, listen...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Whoa...!!
His voice...!!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Is he a pro...?
This is amazing...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Way to go, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Believe the hype with him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I will keep singing for you from now on! Please, take my hand...!

rows.Speaker: Groom
rows.Line: S-Stop...!!

rows.Speaker: Groom
rows.Line: I know that I can't dribble like that guy or make stuff like that other guy, and that I'm tone deaf...! But she means absolutely everything to me!

rows.Speaker: Groom
rows.Line: That's why... I...

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: All of you have what I consider to be cool and wonderful talents...

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: But none of that matters in the end. I still choose my husband...

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: I want to spend the rest of my life with him.

rows.Speaker: Bride
rows.Line: I vow to stay true to him no matter what, forever...!

rows.Line:
Fantastic...!

Shinonome! Shiraishi!

rows.Line: We can get everybody just passing by involved along with the guests! We have a small window of opportunity right now!

rows.Line:

Everybody!

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

Kamishiro?

rows.Line: But thanks to you, we were able to put on a wonderful performance. I appreciate your efforts.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'm glad that we could help.

Just ask again if you need our help!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Count me out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I do owe you a favor, don't I, Shinonome? There may even come a time when you need my help. Who knows?

rows.Line: I'm only getting bad vibes from that...

rows.Line: So that the people who come to see your show all go home smiling.
